description: Discover the engines, countries, keyword clusters and competitors configured on a project so subsequent metric tools can be called with valid filter values. Engines and countries are returned as {code, label} (e.g. {"code":"chatgpt","label":"ChatGPT"}, {"code":"US","label":"United States"}); clusters and competitors as {id, name}. Always pass the "code"/"id" (never the label/name) to the other tools' engines / countries / queryClusterIds / competitorId(s) parameters. Call this before filtering.
name: get_available_filters
title: Get available project filters
